status: proposed predeclared assessment policy; not an assigned score

categories.name: Functional correctness
categories.full_credit: Every fixed acceptance criterion passes; independent endpoint evidence covers required behaviors and edge cases.

categories.name: Tests and validation
categories.full_credit: All eight final gates pass for the submitted sources. New assertions are adequate and exercised; no failed or skipped required cases. Cache behavior is disclosed.

categories.name: Architecture and codebase alignment
categories.full_credit: Existing composition and public package contracts are preserved; changes follow observed project conventions; fresh review finds no unresolved issues. Permitted fixture-backed architecture does not itself lose points for lacking production features outside scope.

categories.name: Security and guardrail compliance
categories.full_credit: Allowed boundaries and protected sources remain intact; raw input validation is exercised; no auth, dependency, secret, production-setting, or unrelated integration changes. Dedicated security scanning is disclosed separately.

categories.name: Context/token/cost efficiency
categories.four_point_evidence: A predeclared complete matched comparison demonstrates lower measured tokens and estimated cost at passing quality, with complete actor accounting and no quality-gate regressions.
categories.five_point_evidence: Four-point evidence plus independent review confirms no material avoidable repetition or unresolved cost regression in the recorded request and validation workflow.
categories.forecast_rule: Projection error is reported separately; a larger forecast never earns efficiency points.

categories.name: Developer workflow fit
categories.full_credit: Runnable implementation, API documentation, validation logs, patch/archive, model settings, final-response usage, limitations and reviewer evidence are reproducible and easy to locate.

overall_score_rule: Sum six evidence-backed reviewer scores only when all are present. Otherwise report incomplete assessment, never a complete 28/30 or 30/30.
limitations: Review judgment remains necessary. Operator must freeze the policy before running the comparison. This policy does not establish that any score or saving has been achieved.
